mbsItinerary.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-27): no new foreign trip beyond Cairo (Sep 15); in late September MBS issued a public warning to the Houthis after Washington again rebuffed his direct-strike requests (two calls to Trump on Sep 10). NEW (checked 2026-09-20): MBS TRAVELLED TO CAIRO — HIS FIRST TRIP SINCE PARIS. MBS met Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in Cairo on Tuesday Sep 15, where the two called for free navigation in the Red Sea after Riyadh vowed a firm response to Houthi attacks; Saudi also informed European customers that some late-September crude cargoes will be cancelled (Reuters, three sources). The read: with Washington refusing direct military help, MBS is working the Arab/Mediterranean axis instead. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-13): NO NEW MBS TRIP SINCE PARIS — but MBS spent the week on the phone to Washington. Reuters (Sep 11-12, confirming an earlier Axios report): MBS called President Trump AT LEAST TWICE on Thursday Sep 10 to request US military help against the Houthis after the East-West pipeline attack and the Houthi seizure of Mokha and Perim island; Washington told Riyadh it was not willing to take direct military action for now but would help with intelligence sharing and targeting — the White House is 'not enthusiastic about getting involved'. Trump (Saturday, asked about the call): Iran was 'probably' behind the pipeline attack, adding 'he's a good friend of mine, and I can just say everything's going to work out fine and dandy'; he also said of increasing military pressure on Iran, 'Maybe I don't do that because of the election.' The tell: Saudi Arabia is now the supplicant in the relationship, and the US answer was partial — the first real test of the alliance since the crisis began. Also in the window: Oman's Sultan Haitham bin Tarik paid a 'fraternal visit' to Saudi Arabia on Sep 1, meeting MBS in Jeddah with the Saudi energy, foreign, commerce, tourism, transport and investment ministers plus the intelligence chief present — Oman is the venue for the GCC–Iran shipping talks on Monday Sep 14. PRIOR: MBS's Paris state visit Aug 22-24 (first foreign trip since the crisis; Macron at the Esports World Cup, agreements on health/transport/energy, mooted €6B Dragon Ball theme park). Bloomberg (Sep 4): the Esports World Cup was moved out of Riyadh because of the Iran war. Foreign-policy lean unchanged — Saudi is courting Paris to diversify beyond Washington. Updated 2026-09-27
mbsItinerary.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-27）：除9月15日开罗外无新出访；9月下旬MBS在华盛顿再度拒绝其直接打击请求（9月10日两次致电特朗普）后公开警告胡塞。 新（核查于2026-09-20）：MBS出访开罗——巴黎以来首次外访。MBS 9月15日（周二）在开罗会见埃及总统塞西，二人呼吁红海航行自由（此前利雅得誓言对胡塞袭击作出强硬回应）；沙特同时告知欧洲客户部分9月下旬原油货载将被取消（路透，三名消息人士）。解读：在华盛顿拒绝直接军事援助后，MBS转向经营阿拉伯/地中海轴。前情（核查于2026-09-13）：巴黎之后MBS无新出访——但本周他把时间花在与华盛顿通话上。路透（9月11-12日，证实此前Axios报道）：东西管道遇袭与胡塞夺取摩卡和丕林岛后，MBS于9月10日（周四）至少两次致电特朗普总统，请求美军对胡塞提供军事支援；华盛顿告知利雅得暂不愿采取直接军事行动，但将提供情报共享与目标定位协助——白宫'并不热衷于介入'。特朗普（周六，被问及通话）：伊朗'可能'是管道袭击的幕后黑手，并称'他是我的好朋友，我只能说一切都会好起来，安然无事'；谈及对伊加大军事压力时又说，'也许因为选举我暂不这么做'。关键信号：沙特如今在这段关系中成了求助方，而美方只给出部分答复——这是危机爆发以来对同盟的首次真正考验。同窗口另讯：阿曼苏丹海赛姆9月1日对沙特进行'兄弟般访问'，在吉达会见MBS，沙特能源、外交、商务、旅游、交通、投资部长及情报总长均在场——阿曼正是9月14日（周一）海合会-伊朗航运谈判的举办地。前情：MBS巴黎国事访问8月22-24日（危机以来首次外访；马克龙出席电竞世界杯；签署卫生/交通/能源协议；传闻中的€60亿Dragon Ball主题公园）。彭博（9月4日）：电竞世界杯因伊朗战争从利雅得移址。外交取向未变——沙特正拉拢巴黎以多元对冲华盛顿。更新于 2026-09-27

hkmaInterventions.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-27): FED-FOLLOW HIKE; STILL NO INTERVENTION — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.88, source_quality 1.86). On Sep 17 the HKMA raised its base rate 25bp to 4.25%, tracking the Fed's hike to 3.75-4%. The Hong Kong dollar fell to 7.8456 per USD (one-month low) in the afternoon, edging toward the weak side of the 7.75-7.85 band but NOT touching the 7.85 weak-side Convertibility Undertaking. HKMA chief Eddie Yue: the widening HKD-USD interest-rate differential could spur carry trades and push the HKD gradually weaker — but DBS's Samuel Tse does not expect an HKMA intervention, citing a possibly weaker USD and higher local rates plus Hong Kong's new five-year plan. No forced USD sales since June 2025. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-20): USD/HKD ~7.842 hugging the weak side; DBS saw slim near-term intervention odds. Updated 2026-09-27.

pewFavorability.threshold: US declining across allies; China stable-low but improving in Global South
pewFavorability.threshold_zh: 美国在盟友中好感度持续下降；中国稳定偏低但在全球南方改善
pewFavorability.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-27): annual survey — no new print (Spring 2026 release stands; next ~late 2026/2027). NEW (checked 2026-09-20): THE FAVOURABILITY CROSSOVER HAS HAPPENED — China is now viewed more positively than the United States in most of the countries surveyed. Pew Research Center Spring 2026 Global Attitudes Survey (released Jul 15, 2026; 45,658 respondents across 37 countries for the China report, 42,151 across 36 for the comparison report; fieldwork Feb 8-May 13, 2026): across 37 countries the MEDIAN favourable view of China is 51% (39% unfavourable); across 36 countries the median favourable view of the US has fallen to 37% (57% unfavourable). China is seen more positively than the US in 25 countries; the US leads in only six — India, Japan, the Philippines and South Korea plus two others. More people now have confidence in Xi Jinping than in Trump in 22 countries; median confidence in Trump is just 23% with 76% expressing none. Biggest gaps are in Asia-Pacific and the Middle East. Canada illustrates the swing: 2023 — US 57% favourable, China 14%; now — China 44%, US 33%. China's ratings are at or near historic highs in Colombia, Greece, Hungary, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Peru, Singapore, Sri Lanka and Turkey — in several of which US ratings are at record lows. Interference perception: a median of 75% in 17 middle-income countries say the US interferes in other countries' affairs a great deal/fair amount, vs 45% for China; in nearly every country more people see the US as the interferer. Personal freedoms remain the one area where the US is rated higher than China, but that gap is narrowing because the US share has collapsed — in Mexico 35% say China respects its people's freedoms vs 20% for the US. Still-negative pockets: 70%+ unfavourable views of China in Japan, Israel, the US, South Korea and Sweden; Singapore is a clear exception to the wealth/negativity pattern (above-median favourability toward China despite the highest GDP surveyed). Dashboard impact: this is the first release in which the US loses the median-favourability contest to China, and it validates the 'dollar system erosion + US alliance strain' leg of the chain. Next survey expected late 2026/2027. Updated 2026-09-27
pewFavorability.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-27）：年度调查——无新发布（2026年春季结果有效；下次约2026年底/2027年）。 新（核查于2026-09-13）：好感度反超已经发生——中国在多数受访国家中形象优于美国。皮尤研究中心2026年春季全球态度调查（7月15日发布；中国报告样本45,658人、覆盖37国，对比报告42,151人、覆盖36国；实地调查2026年2月8日-5月13日）：37国中位对中国好感51%（不好感39%）；36国中位对美国好感降至37%（不好感57%）。中国在25个国家好感度高于美国；美国仅在六国领先——印度、日本、菲律宾、韩国等。22个国家中信任习近平者多于信任特朗普者；对特朗普的中位信任度仅23%，76%表示不信任。差距最大在亚太和中东。加拿大最具代表性：2023年美国好感57%、中国14%；现为中国44%、美国33%。中国在哥伦比亚、希腊、匈牙利、印尼、马来西亚、墨西哥、尼日利亚、秘鲁、新加坡、斯里兰卡、土耳其的好感度处于或接近历史高位——其中数国美国好感度创历史新低。干涉观感：17个中高收入国家中位75%认为美国大量/一定程度干涉他国事务，中国为45%；几乎每个国家认为美国是干涉者的人都更多。个人自由仍是美国评价高于中国的唯一领域，但差距在收窄，因美国得分大幅下滑——墨西哥35%认为中国政府尊重人民自由，美国为20%。仍偏负面的地区：日本、以色列、美国、韩国、瑞典对中国不好感超70%；新加坡是'富裕即负面'规律的明显例外（调查国中人均GDP最高但对中国好感高于中位）。对仪表盘的意义：这是美方首次在中位好感度竞赛中输给中国，印证了'美元体系侵蚀+美国同盟张力'这一链条环节。下次调查预计2026年底/2027年。更新于 2026-09-27
